caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden object placed centrally against a plain, off-white background. The object is brown and appears to be crafted from a single piece of wood, with a smooth finish and subtle variations in the wood grain. It has a long, flat handle that tapers gently to a rounded end, where there is a small, inlaid heart-shaped detail in dark color. The handle transitions into an elongated oval loop at one end, creating an open space. Attached to the underside of the handle near the loop is a small, curved support structure. The composition is minimal, with all attention focused on the object, and there are no other items or background elements in the image. The artist's signature, "WM McGauley," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Bootjack
